app.title: Einbürgerungstest
app.description: Prepare for the Berlin citizenship test.

common.loadingSlow: Loading is taking longer than expected. You can reload the app to try again.
common.savingSlow: Saving is taking longer than expected. Keep this page open. If the save cannot finish, you can try again.

settings.description: Your progress is stored on this device. A backup includes attempts, tests, and settings.
settings.languageHelp: Questions and answers stay visible in German. When the interface is in English, you can also show English translations while studying.
settings.dateHelp: Optional · today or a future date
settings.exportHelp: Use this backup to copy progress to another device.
settings.resetHelp: You’ll confirm before study history and settings are deleted.
settings.replaced: Backup imported. Your history and settings on this device have been replaced.
settings.previewHelp: Compare the backup with this device before importing.

study.imageError: The question image could not be loaded. Try again.
study.imageHelp: Zoom in to inspect details. Scroll the image with touch, a trackpad, or arrow keys when the image is focused.
study.allComplete: You reached the end of all 310 questions. You can start another pass or review your progress.
study.groupComplete: Your latest answers set progress. Earlier attempts stay in question history.
study.groupCompleted: You reached the end of this group
study.helpBody: Answer each question once per session. Previous and Next retain your answers and feedback. Start a new study session, or open a question from Progress, to answer again. Earlier attempts and saved positions remain.
study.effortAcknowledgment: Good work making time to practise.
study.learnedReason: Two correct answers in a row.

dashboard.title: Get ready for the citizenship test
dashboard.dateHelp: Add a date for your countdown.
dashboard.firstUse: No answers yet. Start studying to track progress.
dashboard.progressHelp: Progress includes questions marked Learning or Learned. One correct answer marks a question Learning; two in a row mark it Learned.
dashboard.savedHelp: Study offline. Back up in Settings before changing devices.
dashboard.offline: You’re offline. Progress is saved on this device.

mock.rules: You can change answers until you submit or time runs out. Leaving early saves an unfinished test that cannot be resumed.
mock.changeHelp: Change answers until the test ends. Results appear afterward.
mock.threshold: You need 17 correct answers to pass.
mock.timeout: Time is up. Saved answers were graded automatically.
mock.unfinishedHelp_one: {{count}} choice saved. This test is not counted as completed and cannot be resumed.
mock.unfinishedHelp_other: {{count}} choices saved. This test is not counted as completed and cannot be resumed.
mock.reviewHelp: Use the review to work through the questions you missed.
mock.reviewHelpBelow: Use the review below to work through the questions you missed.

dialogs.submitBody: Unanswered questions score zero. You cannot change your answers after submitting.
dialogs.exitBody: This test will be saved as unfinished and cannot be resumed.
dialogs.importBody: This backup will replace all history and settings on this device.
dialogs.resetBody: This removes all history and restores default settings on this device. Export a backup first if you want to keep your data.

validation.plannedDate: Choose today or a future test date.
validation.invalidBackup: This backup is invalid or exceeds the supported limits. Choose another exported backup. If its history is dated in the future, check your device clock. Your saved progress is unchanged.
validation.backupTooLarge: This backup exceeds the 10 MiB import limit. Choose a smaller exported backup. Your saved progress is unchanged.

installation.safariHelp: If you’re using another browser, open this page in Safari first.
installation.shareHelp: The Share icon may be at the top or bottom of the screen.
installation.homeHelp: If needed, scroll the Share menu to find this option.
installation.addHelp: Enable “Open as Web App” if shown, then confirm the app name to finish installation.
installation.transferHelp: The installed app has separate storage from Safari. Progress does not transfer automatically. Export a backup in Safari, then import it in the installed app. Review the backup and confirm before replacing data.
installation.separatePreparation: The installed app also needs its own online preparation. Keep it open until it says it is ready offline; preparing Safari does not prepare the installed copy.
installation.iosHelp: Open this site in Safari. Tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”. Enable “Open as Web App” if shown, then tap Add.
installation.androidHelp: Open this site in Chrome. Open the three-dot menu, choose “Install and create shortcut” or “Add to Home screen”, then tap Install and confirm. The menu wording may vary by Chrome version.
installation.chromeHelp: On your Android phone or tablet, open this page in Chrome.
installation.menuHelp: Tap the three-dot menu next to the address bar.
installation.installHelp: Choose “Install and create shortcut” or “Add to Home screen”, then tap Install. The wording may vary by Chrome version.
installation.confirmHelp: Follow the on-screen prompts, then open the app from your Home Screen.

offline.unverified: Offline readiness could not be checked.
offline.verificationHelp: Keep the app open and try again. This check does not change your saved questions or learning progress.
offline.preparing: Preparing all questions and images for offline use…
offline.unsupported: Offline preparation is unavailable in this browser. Open the installed app or use a supported browser over a secure connection.
offline.failureHelp: Some resources could not be saved. Check your connection and available device storage, then try again. Your learning progress is unchanged.

startupRecovery.title: A fresh start is needed
startupRecovery.body: Your saved data isn’t compatible with this version of the app. To continue, you’ll need to start with a fresh profile.
startupRecovery.backupHelp: Your saved data hasn’t been changed. You can download a copy before starting fresh. Your new profile will replace your saved progress and settings.
startupRecovery.resetBody: This permanently removes the saved progress and settings from this browser and starts a fresh profile. Download a copy first if you want to keep the original data.
